title: Claude read-only reviewer is refused `engram source --root … --json`, so it cannot cite the native source_id at its boundaries
outcome: A read-only /review-code child (Claude) can run the read-only `engram source --root <worktree> --json` at its start and end boundaries, or the review brief and policy name a supported read-only way to obtain the same native source_id, so reviewers do not fall back to Git commit/tree/porcelain only.
acceptance: The read-only delegation policy for Claude reviewers either admits `engram source --root <path> --json` (a read-only command) or the refusal is documented with the supported alternative that yields the same complete source_id; the decision and its reason are recorded on this item.

If admitted: a behavioural test of the read-only command classifier shows `engram source --root <path> --json` allowed while mutating engram subcommands stay refused. If not admitted: /review-code and the review brief name the alternative, and a test shows that alternative is permitted under writePolicy readOnly.
The review pair is clean and the full gate passes on the exact landed input (or a doc-only change passes the Markdown link check).
